regions.name: worker
regions.note: main control room and tape access logic

regions.name: main-dispatch
regions.note: read op; op=0 east/read, op=1 south/write

regions.name: write-setup
regions.note: addr/current fetch, delta, consume old/write new

regions.name: current-update
regions.note: shared current register update and ack

scenarios.name: write-read-7
scenarios.note: write 42 at address 7, then read address 7

lanes.name: output-pipe
lanes.expect: read target value moves worker -> output room

lanes.name: read-delta-loop
lanes.expect: read rotates exactly delta=(addr-current)%n cells, not all n cells

lanes.name: write-delta-loop
lanes.expect: write first rotates delta=(addr-current)%n cells to reach target

lanes.name: read-current-fetch
lanes.expect: read addr -> ask current register -> receive current

lanes.name: read-target-access
lanes.expect: after delta loop: r target, output, write same value back

lanes.name: write-target-access
lanes.expect: after delta loop: consume target, read new value, write new value to tape

lanes.name: write-current-advance
lanes.expect: B=delta becomes delta+1; no rest-of-ring pass is needed

lanes.name: current-update-entry
lanes.expect: enter update; B carries delta+1 to add

lanes.name: current-fetch
lanes.expect: send -1 to current register and wait for old current

lanes.name: current-calc
lanes.expect: A=(old+B)%n; B is delta+1 for both read and write

lanes.name: current-store
lanes.expect: store computed A into current register as command 1,value

lanes.name: current-ack
lanes.expect: delay, then fetch register once to wait for store commit
